scripts.dev: npm run games && concurrently -n web,play "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w play"
scripts.build: npm run games && npm run build -w play && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run games && tsc -p packages/game-protocol --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit && tsc -p apps/play --noEmit
scripts.test:emu: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-zukka "vitest run --config vitest.emu.config.ts"
scripts.dev:emu: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-zukka "npm run dev"
